title: Lotofácil 3772 has an estimated prize of R$ 2 million
seoTitle: Lotofácil 3772: Estimated Prize of R$ 2 Million
subtitle: The draw takes place this Wednesday after the previous prize went to Fortaleza
excerpt: Lotofácil 3772 has an estimated prize of R$ 2 million after a single bettor hit all fifteen numbers in the previous contest.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Expectations surrounding Lotofácil draw 3772 are growing among bettors after the previous draw registered a single winner in the top tier. With the main prize not rolling over in draw 3771, Caixa Econômica Federal's estimate for the next draw is R$ 2 million.

Previous draw result and prizes

Draw 3771 took place on a Tuesday at Espaço da Sorte, located in São Paulo. A single bet placed in Fortaleza matched all 15 drawn numbers and took home R$ 1,431,471.60. The winning ticket was bought at Loteria Sumaré without using a syndicate (bolão) or Teimosinha.

In addition to the top tier, the draw awarded prizes in four other categories:

  • 14 hits: 194 winning bets, with a prize of R$ 2,210.21 each
  • 13 hits: 10,027 winning bets, with a prize of R$ 35 each
  • 12 hits: 87,690 winning bets, with a prize of R$ 14 each
  • 11 hits: 473,989 winning bets, with a prize of R$ 7 each

How Lotofácil works

This lottery game is based on a bet slip with 25 available numbers. Bettors must mark between 15 and 20 numbers to compete for prizes. Tickets that match 11, 12, 13, 14, or 15 numbers win prizes.

The bet amount and odds of winning vary depending on the quantity of numbers chosen. The minimum allowed bet is 15 numbers. Draws take place regularly from Monday to Friday at 9 PM, and on Sundays at 11 AM.

Alternative gaming modalities

Players can opt for different formats to place their bets:

  • Surpresinha: The Caixa system chooses the numbers randomly.
  • Teimosinha: Allows you to repeat the same bet for 3, 6, 12, 18, or 24 consecutive draws.
  • Bolão (Syndicate): Splits the cost of the bet and the prize among multiple participants.

Rules for claiming prizes

The winner of any prize tier has a period of 90 calendar days from the draw date to claim the amount. If the prize is not claimed within this period, the funds expire and are transferred to the Student Financing Fund, Fies.

For physical bets, it is mandatory to present the original winning ticket along with an ID document containing the CPF. The institution recommends that bettors write their full name and CPF on the back of the physical ticket to ensure security. For digital bets, the amount is linked directly to the account used on the platform.

With information from G1, Estadão.
